positive_snippets: Nice hotel and rooms breakfast is delicious. Stay is also good. We stayed in the hotel for one night. It has a great location, close to the embassy area in New Delhi. The rooms were nice and clean. I personally like the rooms, makes the areas nice and causy, I would say, only this common area as in the sitting area in the hotel needs a bit of improvement, otherwise all was well and we had a pleasant stay. The staff was polite and helpful.

This hotel offers a comfortable and hassle-free stay. The rooms were clean, the service was good, and the staff was friendly and cooperative. I also appreciated the peaceful environment and convenient location. Everything was well organized, making the experience smooth. Overall, I had a positive experience here It's a good option for anyone looking for a pleasant stay.
